DESCRIPTION:
Export certificate to PEM for an order.

    certes cert pfx <order-id> <password> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <order-id>     
    <password>     

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                                 Prints help information          
    -s, --server <SERVER>                                                       
    -k, --key-path <KEY_PATH>                                                   
        --out-path <OUT_PATH>                                                   
        --private-key <PRIVATE_KEY>                                             
        --friendly-name <FRIENDLY_NAME>                                         
        --issuer <ISSUER>                                                       
        --preferred-chain <PREFERRED_CHAIN>                                     
        --legacy-encryption                    Use 3DES/RC2 instead of AES-256, 
                                               for consumers such as Windows    
                                               Server 2016 and earlier that     
                                               cannot read AES-encrypted PFX    
                                               files
